gizmo.title: Radar chart
gizmo.description: Radar (spider) chart for maturity models and facet scoring, such as HEOSAT. Includes a text alternative and data table.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: Heading for the chart; also used as its accessible name.

configure.title: Categories
configure.description: One category per line. Needs at least 3.

configure.title: Scores
configure.description: Comma separated numbers, one per category in the same order.

configure.title: Target scores
configure.description: Comma separated numbers, one per category in the same order.

configure.title: Compact
configure.description: Smaller chart with no labels, legend or data table. Hover a point to see its values.

advanced.title: Score label
advanced.description: Legend and table label for the scores.

advanced.title: Target label
advanced.description: Legend and table label for the targets.
